answer: Weight each identity by a convex function of bonded stake times tenure, where tenure advances one tick per epoch from a zero start. The marginal delta of influence per added alias shrinks fast: convexity makes one aged stake outweigh the same capital split across N clones, so influence per fake falls toward 1/N. Age accrues as marble veining, a density that forms only through elapsed time and cannot be bought or transferred. Tenure is a raven ledger no clone can backdate and no coalition can mint per identity. A forged age record burns the bond at settlement.
